subject.title: Memory MVP: implement source attribution and provenance model

question: What durable provenance contract should active memory use across memory-core/QMD/builtin search, memory-lancedb, Memory Wiki bridge inputs, promotion, and review/edit flows?
rationale: Source inspection proves the gap, but source authority, durable schema shape, merge/edit semantics, and cross-plugin ownership need maintainer product direction before implementation.

options.title: Define Native Provenance Contract
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical design tracker and settle structured source refs, lineage, and source-required promotion before coding.

options.title: Settle Schema First
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42646 to lock the canonical record/revision model before adding the provenance layer.

options.title: Keep Provenance Wiki-Only For Now
options.body: Treat Memory Wiki as the provenance-rich optional layer while leaving active memory promotion and retrieval contracts unchanged for the moment.

recommendation.title: Define Native Provenance Contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical design tracker and settle structured source refs, lineage, and source-required promotion before coding.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision primarily extends the memory host SDK, active memory contract, and memory-core surfaces where steipete has the strongest feature-history signal.
